bibl.title: The Very First Written Word in Literary Greek. From Homer to Aeschylus.
bibl.seg: Nikos Manousakis, The Very First Written Word in Literary Greek. From Homer to Aeschylus.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XVIII, 2163 (= MP3 33; LDAB 124), fr. 1. - Attempts to tentatively restore the substance of the opening lines of Aeschylus' Myrmidons, the first play of a lost, thematically connected trilogy, in which the poet adapts the Iliadic story of Achilles.
